import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(float)
for x,y in [(0,140),(20,140),(40,140),(60,140),(0,160),(20,160),(40,160),(60,160),(80,160),(100,180),(50,180),(30,180),(20,190),(50,200),(70,200),(120,200),(256,200),(400,200)]: print(x,y,im[y,x])
# Crop left-middle enlarged ASCII values every 2 pixels
chars=' .:-=+*#%@'
for yy in range(116,222,2):
 row=im[yy:yy+2,:160].reshape(2,80,2,3).mean((0,2))
 print(f'{yy:3d} '+''.join(chars[min(9,int(p.mean()/26))] for p in row))
print('saturated color class map: wood=w neutral grey=G dark . black space green=g blue=b')
a=np.array(Image.fromarray(im.astype('uint8')).resize((128,72))).astype(float)
for yy,row in enumerate(a):
 def cl(p):
  r,g,b=p; v=p.mean()
  if v<40:return ' '
  if v<65:return '.'
  if max(p)-min(p)<12:return 'G' if v>110 else ':'
  if r>b+15 and g>b+5:return 'w' if v>100 else 'r'
  return 'b' if b>r+10 else 'g' if g>r+6 else '-'
 print(f'{yy*4:3d} '+''.join(cl(p) for p in row))
PY"
